features.name: Scenario 1 - Message
features.note: All controls present and visual layout faithful (structural cov 9/9). But the core Launch action is broken: in UWP it opens the Windows Security credential dialog; in WinUI it throws 'COMException: The handle is invalid' (missing HWND init for PickAsync). Control responds (writes error to Status) but the feature is dead, so partial not pass.

features.name: Scenario 2 - Message+Caption
features.note: Structural cov 10/10 and visual layout faithful. Shares the same broken PickAsync/HWND path as scenario 1, so the credential picker cannot launch. UWP automated capture also recorded responded:false here (dialog focus behavior), but the WinUI path is definitively broken. Partial.
